integrity: The theorem is supported by a written integral Lefschetz and multiplicative Cartan–Leray argument. The included Python code checks finite E2 tables only; no formal or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complex smooth free-involution complete intersections only. Stable range is cohomological degrees strictly below the complex dimension. Middle cohomology and above, positive characteristic, and nonfree quotients are not classified. Standard spectral-sequence machinery means historical priority remains qualified.
title: Stable-range integral cohomology and Brauer vanishing for Calabi–Yau Enriques complete intersections
